title: couepia chrysocalyx
intro: Couepia chrysocalyx, commonly known as the golden couepia, is a plant species native to the tropical forests of Central and South America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to reduce fever, soothe digestive issues, and relieve respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Couepia chrysocalyx include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
